evals.prompt: Create and start a persistent Goal from this fuzzy request: modernize authentication.
evals.expected_output: Routes first to goal-prompt formation and does not create or activate runtime state before the GoalPackage is researched and user-confirmed.
expectations: The response identifies goal-prompt as the formation owner.
No runtime Goal is created before package confirmation.
Formation includes outcome, DOD, initial solution and milestones.

evals.prompt: Generate a copy-pasteable /goal for this migration. Do not create or run it.
evals.expected_output: Routes to goal-prompt and stops after prompt formation without starting goal-orchestrator runtime state.
expectations: The request is treated as prompt_only.
No native Goal or .goals directory is created.
The orchestrator does not claim runtime ownership.

evals.prompt: Import this confirmed GoalPackage. It has handoff_intent ready; do not start it.
evals.expected_output: Validates and imports the package into the sole runtime state with ready status.
expectations: Package provenance and user confirmation are validated.
The resulting Goal remains ready.
The GoalPackage is not treated as a second state source.

evals.prompt: The active Goal has a routine reversible implementation choice. Decide the next increment.
evals.expected_output: Uses the evidence-bound global steering prompt and direct validation without automatically creating a reviewer subagent.
expectations: The decision maps to Goal outcome and DOD evidence.
Assumptions, alternatives, global effect and rollback are checked.
No reviewer is spawned solely for a routine local decision.

evals.prompt: The same root cause has failed repeatedly, complexity is increasing, and two loops produced no new DOD evidence. Continue the active Goal.
evals.expected_output: Freezes a neutral direction-review packet and asks an independent subagent to assess local-only improvement and dead-end risk before further repair.
expectations: The anomaly triggers a direction reviewer.
The reviewer is read-only and returns continue/replan/research/design/rollback/ask_user/blocked guidance.
The Goal owner validates the recommendation rather than delegating state ownership.

evals.prompt: New evidence requires changing the active Goal's scope and DOD.
evals.expected_output: Enters waiting_for_decision and does not silently update the contract; after user approval it may request a GoalPackageRevision from goal-prompt.
expectations: Agent consensus does not replace the user decision.
The runtime owner retains state ownership during recompilation.
Affected evidence is invalidated after the new contract revision.

evals.prompt: All milestones are marked complete. Mark the active Goal complete.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to infer completion from milestones and runs fresh DOD evidence plus the independent final audit on a frozen revision.
expectations: Every DOD is bound to current contract and artifact revisions.
OCR is run when applicable and a fresh-lineage final reviewer is used.
The Goal is complete only after all findings and pending work are resolved.
